title: File:Fakua Doul Joysagar 03.jpg
author: Nayan j Nath
description: Fakuwa Doul, built by Swargadeo Rudra Singha (1703–1704) in memory of Queen Joymati Kunwari, stands 30 ft high with a 90 ft circumference. Locals believe it to be her burial mound. With its octagonal plinth, eight Angshikharas, and pyramid-like structure, it remains a unique monument of Assam’s heritage.
classification_note: Memorial/shrine with disputed popular burial identification. Keep separate from authenticated Tai-Ahom maidams and generic royal palace references.
